rideSafetyRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-001 Ride Safety
Fail-silent: brakes, controller,
sensors, and BMS cut torque.

rangeRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-002 Range (Tour)
>= 60 km on 500 Wh at
~8.3 Wh/km. Not Eco/PAS-1.

assistLimitRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-003 Assist Limit
EPAC cadence PAS, no throttle.
Cut assist at 25 km/h.

chargeSafetyRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-004 Charge Safety
Stop on over-temp, over-voltage,
or charger disconnect.

brakeOverrideRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-010 Brake Override
Electronic inhibit <= 50 ms.
~10x tighter than EN 15194 m.

structuralRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-030 Structure
Frame carries rider, cargo, and
battery loads without yield.

displayRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-020 Display
Show speed, assist, and remaining
range on the bar display.

batteryCutoffRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-011 Battery Cutoff
BMS inside the pack opens the
contactor (UL 2849).

en15194DistanceRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-012 EN 15194 Distance
Cut assist within 5 m after
pedaling stops (2 m if tighter).

lightingRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-040 Lighting
StVZO / ISO 6742.
Not UN ECE R113.
